text:
violet-sales: Devon from Meridian flagged contract redlines + PO timing. Procurement says PO could be delayed 2 weeks; POC needs to start in 5 days. Can legal confirm minimal docs to start? @kelly-legal

kelly-legal: We can accept a signed DPA + short POC SOW (zero-dollar) to start. MSA can be negotiated in parallel but ask them to upload any MSA redline ASAP. Also request signer roles (legal vs tech).

frank-ops: Ops needs PO number on invoices for production. For POC we can run on eval credits and set SOW value to $0 with a PO-pending note. W-9 required before any paid invoices. Also confirm if they need BYOK for evaluation.

omar-se: Technical note: hosted eval supports our KMS bridge for short trials; Dedicated supports BYOK. If they need BYOK from day one, we'll propose a Dedicated trial slot but that needs longer lead time. For immediate POC, hosted + KMS bridge is easiest.

devon-customer: We can sign the DPA + SOW today. Contoso legal wants to see the MSA redline but agrees to SOW for trial. We use DocuSign. I will route.

cert-bot: Attached: SOC2 Type II and pen test summary (link).

violet-sales: OK plan: 1) Send DPA + zero-dollar SOW via DocuSign 2) Provision hosted sandbox with KMS bridge 3) Start POC. If Meridian pushes for MSA redlines, request their redline doc and continue POC in parallel.

kelly-legal: Confirmed. DPA should include controller instructions and 15-day deletion timeline after termination for trial data. I'll prep a short redline and upload to Drive. Also add explicit "no charge" language for the trial in the SOW.

frank-ops: Reserving eval slot Thu 10:00-16:00 UTC pending signed SOW. Add PO placeholder (PO: pending) on SOW document.

devon-customer: DocuSign route: I will sign SOW as technical sponsor and forward to legal for DPA/MSA as needed.

omar-se: I'll prep access and a short onboarding note. Suggested billing clause in SOW:

```
Trial Billing: The Trial period is non-billable. No charges will be assessed until Customer executes an Order Form for Production.
```

kelly-legal: That clause is fine; one minor edit to reserve right to invoice for optional paid add-ons if Customer explicitly opts in. Uploading redline now.

violet-sales: I'll send the packet and drop the DocuSign envelope id here once sent. Thanks team :rocket:
